vendor_policies.policy: Strict Minimum Advertised Price (MAP) adherence required by manufacturer contract. Maximum allowable undercut against competitor is $2.00, provided the final price remains at or above MAP.
Dynamic clearance discounting permitted. Repricing engine allowed to discount aggressively down to COGS + 10% to liquidate seasonal inventory.
Standard margin protection. Prices must maintain at least COGS + 15% floor unless promotional waiver is active.
